title: Does hollow mean flight?
hook: One bone feature does not settle a question about movement.

knows: Fossils and models can supply evidence about the past.
doesNotKnow: Both schematic bones have an empty interior, but the diagram supplies no evidence that either animal flew. Hollow bones occur in flying birds and some non-flying dinosaurs, so the feature alone cannot establish flight.

misconception: A hollow bone alone proves an animal could fly.
objective: Two animals have hollow bones in this comparison. Can that feature alone prove both animals flew?
